head_commit.message:
chore(vellum): record the browser-capture-tree include as a watch event

test/test_browser_capture_tree.cpp matches the chromium-authoring-frontend
selector, so the one include the widened lanes needed makes the trusted base
executor demand a watch event for that family. The change is a direct <array>
include for a std::array the file already constructed and had been getting
transitively; nothing about capture, custody, output, or DesignIR moves.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
